subject: Shiny apps don't always load without browswer focus

messages.author: 5ab11db47365dff1
messages.subject: Shiny apps don't always load without browswer focus
parts:
Hi everyone,

I run shiny open server on ubuntu 14.04 with a shiny app, r base 3.2 -- every package in R, and R itself, are on the latest repos.

The shiny-server setup is on its default settings.  we use nginx to proxy through requests to the :3838 tab.

Our app has different pages that sometimes people may load up in a new tab.

If the tab doesn't have focus, the page won't always load.  Try it here:

http://www.letsrun.com/shoes/

And open up a shoe page link in a new tab and let it load in the background.  It won't load up.

I know there are listeners in Shiny, for example, that do not load plots that aren't in visible tabs.  Is there a similar property if the browser doesn't have focus. And is there an option to override it?

If it matters, the shiny app is nested in an iframe, and gets what shoes to load up using javascript and hidden fields. I don't think that matters.

Thanks you.

Erik

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny apps don't always load without browswer focus
parts:
Hmmm, I'm not sure what's causing this. If it's the feature for not loading outputs when they're not visible (which seems likely, though I wouldn't have expected it to work at the browser tab level) you can override it on a per-output basis like so:

outputOptions(output, "shoeDescriptionTable", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)

Can you try that on a couple of the outputs and let me know if that makes a difference?

I don't think we have an application-wide preference for this, but perhaps we ought to.
